slides.subtitle: I was wondering… / Were you wanting…?
goals: Use past and continuous forms for politeness.

slides.title: Form and effect

head: Neutral
Distanced / tentative
rows: I want to ask you something.
I **was wanting** to ask you something.
Will you be paying by card?

slides.tip: The past here does not refer to past time; it creates **distance**, which sounds more polite.
